model: Temporal edge GNN (diff attention), IBM AML HI-Small laundering detection
selected: seed 0 = best valid PR-AUC of 3 seeds
note: Currency/format embedding ids come from ml.models.gnn.data.load_aml factorisation of HI-Small_Trans.csv; rebuild the cache from the same CSV. Feature normalisation stats are stored in the state_dict (edge_enc.mean / edge_enc.std). Diff and vanilla attention are statistically tied on this data; see ml/reports/gnn_aml.md.
usage: ck = torch.load('aml_diff.pt', weights_only=False); sd = ck['state_dict']; m = TemporalEdgeModel(7, g.n_cur, g.n_fmt, sd['edge_enc.mean'], sd['edge_enc.std'], d_model=128, heads=4, attn='diff'); m.load_state_dict(sd); p = models.gnn.train.predict(m, EdgeData(g, 'cuda', 32), edge_ids, 16384)
